# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase-2.118.0.js` is the unmodified UMD browser bundle of
`@supabase/supabase-js` 2.118.0 (MIT), retrieved from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0/dist/umd/supabase.js.

It is served from the application origin so that a previously installed app can
start without a CDN connection. Update the filename and service-worker assets
when updating the SDK. Upstream: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js.
